notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
